announcement.quote: This is a brief overview of the reorganization proposed for Highland Opportunistic Credit Fund (the “Selling Fund”) and NexPoint Opportunistic Credit Fund (the “Buying Fund”).

deals.notes: Three N-14 filings (original and two pre-effective amendments, to 2017-01-11) all describe the proposed reorganization; none states an outcome. The fund classes shown (Class A, C, Z with sales loads and CDSC) are not stated to be exchange-listed.

problems: Outcome not stated; listing status of both funds not stated.
